nodes.label: txt2img.py main()
nodes.desc: Argument parsing, model construction, seed handling, and the batch loop that assembles the image grid.

nodes.label: load_model_from_config
nodes.desc: torch.load's the .ckpt on CPU and rebuilds the model from its YAML description.

nodes.label: Sampling Loop
nodes.desc: Encodes the prompt, calls sampler.sample, decodes latents through the first stage, watermarks, and appends to the grid.

nodes.label: instantiate_from_config
nodes.desc: Resolves target strings like ldm.models...LatentDiffusion into live objects with injected params.

nodes.label: DDIMSampler
nodes.desc: Deterministic DDIM sampler with make_schedule buffers and classifier-free guidance.

nodes.label: DDIMSampler.ddim_sampling
nodes.desc: The time-step loop calling p_sample_ddim; decode() supports img2img starts via stochastic_encode.

nodes.label: p_sample_ddim
nodes.desc: One DDIM step: predict eps with guidance, mix x0 prediction and direction per eta.

nodes.label: PLMSSampler
nodes.desc: Pseudo-linear multistep sampler, default for the txt2img reference script.

nodes.label: p_sample_plms
nodes.desc: Order-4 multistep update tracking previous eps estimates for faster convergence.

nodes.label: LatentDiffusion.apply_model
nodes.desc: Concatenates cond/uncond batches, routes x_noisy through the UNet, splices outputs for guidance.

nodes.label: LatentDiffusion
nodes.desc: Wraps a first-stage autoencoder, conditioning encoders, and the UNet into one training and sampling object.

nodes.label: DDPM
nodes.desc: Base class holding the beta schedule, q_sample noising, and ancestral p_sample_loop.

nodes.label: LatentDiffusion.p_losses
nodes.desc: The training objective: noise latents with q_sample, predict eps with the UNet, plus optional decoder losses.

nodes.label: DDPM.q_sample
nodes.desc: Forward-process noising: sqrt(alpha_bar)*x0 + sqrt(1-alpha_bar)*noise.

nodes.label: UNetModel
nodes.desc: 860M-parameter U-Net with residual blocks, spatial transformers, and skip connections.

nodes.label: UNetModel.forward
nodes.desc: Embeds timesteps, pushes through input blocks saving skips, runs the middle block, then fuses skips in output blocks.

nodes.label: TimestepEmbedSequential
nodes.desc: Sequence wrapper that dispatches (x, emb, context) to ResBlock, SpatialTransformer, or Downsample children.

nodes.label: time_embed MLP
nodes.desc: SiLU MLP expanding the sinusoidal timestep embedding into model-wide conditioning.

nodes.label: timestep_embedding
nodes.desc: Sinusoidal embedding function borrowed from the OpenAI guided-diffusion codebase.

nodes.label: ResBlock (UNet)
nodes.desc: Residual conv block that adds the timestep embedding via scale-shift or addition.

nodes.label: SpatialTransformer
nodes.desc: Projects feature maps in, runs a stack of transformer blocks over spatial positions, projects out.

nodes.label: BasicTransformerBlock
nodes.desc: Self-attention, then cross-attention to context, then a feed-forward network.

nodes.label: CrossAttention
nodes.desc: q from image features, k/v from the 77x768 text embedding; the crux of prompt guidance.

nodes.label: AutoencoderKL
nodes.desc: KL-regularized first stage that owns encode/decode between pixels and latents.

nodes.label: AutoencoderKL.encode
nodes.desc: Predicts moments and samples DiagonalGaussianDistribution: 512x512x3 pixels become 64x64x4 latents.

nodes.label: AutoencoderKL.decode
nodes.desc: Scales latents by scale_factor and runs the decoder to reconstruct images.

nodes.label: Encoder (VAE)
nodes.desc: Downsampling conv stack with ResnetBlocks and AttnBlock, outputs mean and logvar.

nodes.label: Decoder (VAE)
nodes.desc: Mirrored upsampling stack that turns the 64x64x4 latent back into pixels.

nodes.label: ResnetBlock (VAE)
nodes.desc: GroupNorm-SiLU-conv residual block shared by the encoder and decoder paths.

nodes.label: AttnBlock (VAE)
nodes.desc: Single-head self-attention over the spatial grid at the bottleneck.

nodes.label: FrozenCLIPEmbedder
nodes.desc: Frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder kept in eval mode; prompts become conditioning context.

nodes.label: FrozenCLIPEmbedder.encode
nodes.desc: Tokenizes text, runs the transformer, returns the last hidden states as 77x768 embeddings.
